title: Elterngeld Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Three Lebensmonate is the whole retroactive window.** Elterngeld is paid back only for the last three months of your child's life before the month the application arrives, so post the form early even if the split is still undecided.

**Basiselterngeld is about 65 percent of a net the law builds itself**, counted up to **2,770 euros**, which gives a range of **300 to 1,800 euros** a month. Bonuses, a thirteenth salary, Urlaubsgeld and Weihnachtsgeld are all left out of it.

**A couple shares 14 months, one parent alone gets 12.** The 13th and 14th exist only if the second parent takes at least two. Both parents may draw Basiselterngeld in the same month once, inside the first twelve.

**One Basis month converts into two ElterngeldPlus months** and can run to the **32nd Lebensmonat**. After month 14 the run may not be interrupted: one empty month ends the entitlement even with months left over.

**Berlin is on paper right now.** The city's digital Elterngeld portal is being rebuilt, so new applications go by post to your district Elterngeldstelle, with the birth certificate in the original and your own Mutterschaftsgeld certificate enclosed.
**Above 175,000 euros of taxable income there is nothing**, for births from 1 April 2025, couples and single parents alike. The 2024 births up to 31 March 2025 keep the older 200,000 euro line.
